# ProFX Club

> ProFX Club is a free forex trader membership and community: beginner-friendly trading education,
> live classes and webinars, a moderated worldwide community, events, travel interest lists and
> member assistance. No deposit, no broker account and no payment required to join.
> All educational content is for learning purposes only and is not financial advice.

### Risk Management
- [Position Sizing 101: Risk Only What You Can Lose](https://dawoodshah2232-svg.github.io/profx-club/blog/position-sizing-101.html): Position size decides whether a losing trade is a lesson or a disaster. Learn the simple math behind smart sizing.
- [Stop-Loss Orders: Your Safety Net Explained](https://dawoodshah2232-svg.github.io/profx-club/blog/stop-loss-orders-explained.html): A stop-loss exits your trade automatically at a chosen price. How they work, where to place them, and mistakes to avoid.
- [The 1% Risk Rule Every Beginner Should Know](https://dawoodshah2232-svg.github.io/profx-club/blog/one-percent-risk-rule.html): Risk no more than 1% of your account on any single trade. The simple rule that keeps beginners alive long enough to learn.
- [Leverage Explained: Power and Danger](https://dawoodshah2232-svg.github.io/profx-club/blog/leverage-explained-power-danger.html): Leverage multiplies both gains and losses. Understand how 1:100 really works before you touch it.
- [Margin Calls: What They Are and How to Avoid Them](https://dawoodshah2232-svg.github.io/profx-club/blog/margin-calls-avoid.html): A margin call means your broker is warning you: add funds or lose positions. What triggers them and how to never get one.
- [Risk-Reward Ratios: Plan Every Trade](https://dawoodshah2232-svg.github.io/profx-club/blog/risk-reward-ratios-guide.html): A 1:2 risk-reward ratio means one winner pays for two losers. How to plan exits so your winners carry your losers.
- [Drawdowns: Surviving Losing Streaks](https://dawoodshah2232-svg.github.io/profx-club/blog/drawdowns-surviving-losing-streaks.html): Every trader faces losing streaks. What drawdown means, why it is normal, and the rules that keep a bad month from ending you.
- [Building a Trading Plan That Controls Risk](https://dawoodshah2232-svg.github.io/profx-club/blog/trading-plan-controls-risk.html): A trading plan turns impulses into process. The essential sections every beginner's plan needs — with a simple template.

### Trading Psychology
- [FOMO in Trading: How to Beat It](https://dawoodshah2232-svg.github.io/profx-club/blog/fomo-in-trading-how-to-beat-it.html): Fear of missing out makes traders chase moves too late. Recognise FOMO and replace it with a calmer process.
- [Revenge Trading: Why It Destroys Accounts](https://dawoodshah2232-svg.github.io/profx-club/blog/revenge-trading-destroys-accounts.html): After a loss, the urge to 'win it back' is overwhelming — and account-destroying. How revenge trading works and how to stop it.
- [Patience: The Underrated Trading Skill](https://dawoodshah2232-svg.github.io/profx-club/blog/patience-trading-skill.html): Waiting is a trading action. Why patience beats constant activity — and how to build it like a muscle.
- [Keeping a Trading Journal That Works](https://dawoodshah2232-svg.github.io/profx-club/blog/trading-journal-that-works.html): A trading journal turns random trades into data. What to record, how to review it, and the template that actually helps.

- [Confirmation Bias: Seeing What You Want](https://dawoodshah2232-svg.github.io/profx-club/blog/confirmation-bias-trading.html): Your brain highlights evidence that agrees with your trade and hides the rest. How to fight confirmation bias in trading.
- [Discipline Over Motivation in Trading](https://dawoodshah2232-svg.github.io/profx-club/blog/discipline-over-motivation-trading.html): Motivation fades by February; discipline compounds for years. How to build trading discipline that survives bad weeks.
- [Taking Breaks: When Not to Trade](https://dawoodshah2232-svg.github.io/profx-club/blog/taking-breaks-when-not-to-trade.html): The best trade is often no trade. Recognise the conditions — in markets and in yourself — when stepping away wins.
